subject: Reactivity breaks when viewing in browsing window

messages.author: 22b20bb346174761
messages.subject: Reactivity breaks when viewing in browsing window
parts:
Hi all,
I just updated R and Rstudio to the latest version (R: 3.1.2 and Rstudio: 0.98.1091). My system is OS X Mavericks and the shiny version is 0.10.2.2. When I was running a shiny application within the pop up window in Rstudio, everything is OK. But when I click "open in browser" and open a new window in Chrome, many reactivities seems to break. For example a datatableOutput does not show up after typing in some values in a textInput.
Then I updated the shiny to the newest development version. The datatableOutput now works but the radioButtons and conditionalPanel breaks down.
I wonder whether it is the problem with my web browser since everything works perfect in the pop up window within Rstudio.

messages.subject: Re: Reactivity breaks when viewing in browsing window
parts:
After launching the app in Chrome, if user type in any number (for example 2) in the textInput box "Specify Entrez GeneID for Positive Genes" on the left sidebar panel, there should be a dataTable in the middle showing up. However, now it is not showing up. Probably you can try running it in Safari where everything works well.
There is a demo video on Youtube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1OeZ1PAUMhw
The UI has changed a little bit but the effects are similar.
Thanks a lot for looking into the issue! This issue is quite important for us since we are going to submit the software to a peer-reviewed journal and we want the GUI to be stable.
